No external parallels in Chinese, Sanskrit, or Tibetan corpora are recorded [DharmaNexus]. However, automated analysis via DharmaNexus reveals extensive formulaic text-reuse within the Pali canon and its commentaries, comprising 36 matching passages shared across 12 Pali texts [DharmaNexus].
